简历：
Prof Jenkins is an endocrinologist and clinician-researcher specializing in diabetes and vascular medicine.
She currently leads the Diabetes and Vascular Medicine Laboratory at the Baker Heart and Diabetes Institute in Melbourne. Prof Jenkins has over 30 years of clinical and research experience, focusing on preventing complications from type 1 and type 2 diabetes and heart disease. Her work emphasizes integrating technology into healthcare, including insulin pumps, glucose sensors and telemedicine. She has led major clinical trials such as REMOVAL, FIELD, and FAME-1 Eye.
Prof Jenkins is also actively involved in initiatives to support the provision of diabetes care in emergency situations and was co-Chair of the IDF-WPR Diabetes Care and Disaster Guidelines.

简历：
Julia Mader is Associate Professor of Medicine at the Division of Endocrinology and Diabetology at Medical University of Graz, Austria.
Professor Mader is Board member of the European Association for the Study of Diabetes and Chair of the EASD Postgraduate Education Committee, member of the Austrian Society for Internal Medicine, the Austrian Diabetes Association and the Austrian Society for Endocrinology.
She is management board member of the Austrian Diabetes Society, within which she heads the Diabetes Education Committee and is a member of the Diabetes Technology Committee. Professor Mader has authored and co-authored several national guidelines in the field.
Professor Mader leads the Diabetes Technology Research Unit at Medical University of Graz. Her research is focused on diabetes technology with emphasis on insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitoring, the artificial pancreas and decision support systems for the treatment of diabetes.
She has published over 140 peer-reviewed scientific papers and serves as Associate Editor for Trials. She has received several national and international awards in the field of diabetes technology.

简历：
### 个人简介
1. 毛百微，上海交通大学医学院2026级内分泌与代谢学博士研究生，师从王育璠教授。
2. 主要研究方向为糖尿病及其慢性并发症、肾脏损伤与修复。聚焦糖尿病微血管并发症，重点研究糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）与糖尿病肾脏病（DKD）的早期识别、疾病进展、器官异质性及潜在分子机制。
3. 临床研究方面，参与多项糖尿病临床队列研究，综合运用代谢组学、蛋白组学及统计建模等方法，探索糖尿病微血管并发症的早期预测与精准风险分层；基础研究方面，聚焦肾脏及视网膜的损伤修复及器官易感性的分子机制，围绕细胞衰老、代谢重编程及潜在干预靶点开展研究。
4. 以第一作者、共同作者身份在《Renal Failure》《Materials Today Bio》等国际期刊发表多篇研究论文。
5. 曾获内分泌代谢学东方会青年优秀论文奖、中华医学会肾脏病学年会优秀论文奖、海上肾脏论坛优秀论文奖、重症肾脏病与血液净化大会论文一等奖等。

Biography
Dr. Cong-Yi (CY) Wang is the Scientific Director of the Diabetes Research Center at the Qatar Biomedical Research Institute. He earned his Ph.D. in Medical Immunology from Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, China. After completion of his postdoctoral training in population genetics, genomics, and immunology of type 1 diabetes (T1D) at the University of Florida, he was then appointed as a tenure-track Assistant Professor at the Center for Biotechnology and Genomic Medicine, Medical College of Georgia (now Augusta University). He was also appointed Scientific Director of the Georgia Exoteric and Molecular Laboratories LLC, at the Medical College of Georgia Health Science Center after his promotion.
In 2014, Dr. Wang was recruited by the Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, as a tenured professor. At Tongji Hospital, he established the Center for Biomedical Research, Tongji Biobank, and the Tongji SPF Animal Center. He served as Director of the Center for Biomedical Research, Tongji Biobank, and the National Health Commission Key Laboratory of Respiratory Diseases, as well as Executive Director of Sponsored Program Administration.
Dr. Wang’s research focuses on the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of type 1 and type 2 diabetes. Thus far, Dr. Wang has published > 250 peer viewed scientific papers and produced > 20 national and international patents.

简历：
薛欣宇，1981年生。电子科技大学物理学院教授，教育部新世纪优秀人才、四川省峨眉学者，四川省杰出青年基金获得者、辽宁省“百千万”人才工程百人层次、辽宁省高等学校优秀人才第一层次人才、沈阳市中青年科技创新人才。
2003年，获南京大学物理系学士学位；2008年，获中国科学院物理研究所凝聚态物理博士学位；2008-2018年，在东北大学物理系先后任副教授和教授；2011-2012年，在美国佐治亚理工学院博士后；2019年1月至今，在电子科技大学物理学院任教授。
研究微纳能源与相关系统，设计研发新型传感系统和无线无电池生物医学工程器件，目前主要应用在医学生物检测芯片、癌症肿瘤治疗、眼底疾病干预、慢性疾病诊疗和脑机接口等方面。
授权发明专利和实用新型专利20多项，授权美国专利3项；在Nature Sustain、Nature Commun、Science Adv等SCI期刊上发表学术论文170多篇，SCI他引超1万次，h指数60。其中，研究成果“自充电电池”被英国物理学会评为2012年度世界十大科学突破（第一作者）。“表面力电耦合效应及多功能器件”获评2016年省科技奖自然科学类二等奖（排名第一）。主持国家级和省部级项目20多项。

陈文明，复旦大学可信具身智能研究院研究员，Biomech-X实验室负责人，博士生导师，上海创智学院（具身智能与AI系统）全时导师。研究领域为生物力学、多维力（触）觉技术、先进假肢与外骨骼系统。承担国家自然科学基金委面上项目、联合基金项目，科技部“国家重点研发计划”，军委科技委重点项目，上海市“通用人工智能大模型”基础研究专项等。致力于生物力学与具身智能交叉领域研究，是国内较早从事基础生物力学（Biomechanics）到人体肢体仿生（Bionics）创新设计的学者之一。研究成果助行外骨骼、可编程触觉假肢被中央电视台科教频道、新民晚报等专题报道。主导研发超越人类指尖灵敏度的“自适应视触觉AI传感器”（电子皮肤），为机器人的类人操作（如抓取易碎品）、精细化微创手术及智能假肢触觉反馈提供关键技术，成果亮相于2025世界人工智能大会（WAIC）被誉为“镇馆之宝”。迄今已发表论文 110 余篇，获得国家专利授权20余项，拥有多项成功实现成果转化的技术。曾获得国际生物力学学会（ISB）颁发的Martyn Shorten创新奖、日本机械学会（JSME）颁发的Yamaguchi奖牌等多项荣誉。受邀担任工信部 “外骨骼机器人性能测试方法” 行业标准工作组专家、可穿戴机器人领域国家标准工作组专家。担任《Applied Bionics and Biomechanics》（Wiley）、《 Gait & Posture 》（Elsevier）、《医用生物力学》、《应用力学学报》等国内外期刊编委。
